title: On Being a good listener for once
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：be　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 be 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the porter ① was a good listener for once at once, and every visitor in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the porter ② is a good listener for once in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ be a good listener for once at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ been a good listener for once before — a line in the journal for August 1953 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Being a good listener for once at once, the porter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ be the first to leave in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Be the first to leave at once and never mention it again.

By 1966 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new visitor from the next coast ⑧ is the first to leave at once every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the cove, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ was a good listener for once again when nobody else would.

⑩ To be a good listener for once, my mother said in 1971, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the coast remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the coast forgets, somebody is a good listener for once in the rain again and somebody must be a good listener for once at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 成为（一般过去式 was a good listener for once：1959 年挑夫头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 成为（一般现在 is a good listener for once：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 成为（不定式 to be a good listener for once：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 成为（过去完成时 had been a good listener for once：1953 年八月的行记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 成为（动名词 being a good listener for once 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 当上（be the first to leave：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去当上头一个离开的人）
G. v. 当上（be the first to leave：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 成为（后段两处：新来的游客照例 is the first to leave，而母亲又一次 was a good listener for once）

answers.why: be 意为“成为”，1959 年挑夫二话不说地成为头一回当一个好听众，那是海岸里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 was。
be 意为“成为”，自那以后挑夫淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 is。
be 意为“成为”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯成为头一回当一个好听众”，此处为不定式 to be a good listener for once。
be 意为“成为”，行记里 八月 那行字说明早在 1966 年之前就有人成为过，故用过去完成时 had been。
be 意为“成为”，挑夫说“成为头一回当一个好听众这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 being a good listener for once 作主语。
be 意为“当上”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去当上头一个离开的人”，should ever 之后用原形 be the first to leave。
be 意为“当上”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻当上头一个离开的人（be the first to leave at once），以后再也不要提起。
be 意为“成为”，新来的游客每个星期都照例当上头一个离开的人，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 is。
be 意为“成为”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地成为头一回当一个好听众，用一般过去式 was 叙述。
be 意为“成为”，结尾那句是母亲 1971 年的话：要成为头一回当一个好听众，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和海岸记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，挑夫二话不说地成为头一回当一个好听众；海岸里每一个游客都说这是头一回。（was a good listener for once）
多年以后，挑夫仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（is a good listener for once）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯成为头一回当一个好听众这件事本身。（to be a good listener for once）
早在 1953 年就有人成为头一回当一个好听众，八月那天行记上的一行字就是证据。（had been a good listener for once）
挑夫说过，二话不说地成为头一回当一个好听众这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（being a good listener for once 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻当上头一个离开的人，以后再也不要提起。（be the first to leave，祈使句）
answers: In 1959 the porter was a good listener for once at once, and every visitor in the coast said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the porter still is a good listener for once in the rain without being asked.
My mother said later that to be a good listener for once at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had been a good listener for once long before 1966, and the line in the journal for August proves it.
Being a good listener for once at once, the porter said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Be the first to leave at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 be 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the porter was a good listener for once at once, and nobody in the coast forgot it.
Even now the porter is a good listener for once in the rain whenever the coast asks.
Being a good listener for once at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever be the first to leave in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new visitor from the next coast is the first to leave at once every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother was a good listener for once again, and the coast remembered that half.
